# Aorila

> Aorila is an AI API. Base URL: https://api.aorila.com
> OpenAI-compatible chat. Compute rental is a separate product — not on this host.

Keys, model aliases, and upstream URLs live in process environment on the API host. Not in Supabase.

## Fetch these

- [AI API](https://aorila.com/docs/ai.md): models, auth, chat completions
- [Full text](https://aorila.com/llms-full.txt): same docs in one file
- [Request access](https://api.aorila.com/): key request page

## Optional

- [Site](https://aorila.com/)
- [Labs](https://aorilalabs.com/)
- [Support](https://aorila.com/support)
